title: A sharp raises a note
summary: Read the # sign as one fret higher.

steps.title: One fret higher
steps.body:
A **sharp** is the # sign after a note letter. It means one half step higher than that letter without a sign. A# is one fret higher than A on the same string.

**Why it matters:** The sign gives a name to the sound between A and B.

steps.title: A becomes A#
steps.body: On string 5, open A becomes A# at fret 1. Follow the move from A to A#. You may see another spelling in the app; we will explain it in the next lesson.

items.prompt: Play A#2. Use any lit position.

steps.title: Raise a familiar letter
steps.body: Play open A, then fret 1 on the same string. Say A, then A sharp. You can use the on-screen fretboard instead of a guitar.
